name: Beclobrate

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Switzerland, first in 1990 — for liver harm

similar.name: Clofibrate
problems: Pulled from the market in Israel and 2 other countries, first in 1979 — for blood vessel problems and cancer risk

similar.name: Cloforex
problems: Pulled from the market in Germany and Sweden, first in 1969 — for breathing problems and heart harm

similar.name: Chlorphentermine
problems: Pulled from the market in Germany and Venezuela, first in 1967 — for breathing problems and heart harm

summary: Beclobrate was removed from the market in Switzerland starting in 1990 because of damage to the liver [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on human beings, the drug received a low score of 42 for liver issues and a medium score of 52 for heart issues [M]. Related drugs have also been taken off the market in several countries for blood vessel damage, the ability to cause cancer (carcinogenicity), breathing problems, and heart damage [3].
